led_count.evidence: Three red LEDs are clearly visible in a vertical row on the breadboard.

resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors with color bands are visible, each connected to the cathode side of one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The LEDs are oriented with their flat side (cathode) facing the resistors, which is the correct standard orientation for this setup.

photoresistor.evidence: A photoresistor (small disc with a snake-like pattern) is visible at the bottom of the breadboard area.

photo_pin.evidence: A green wire connects the row containing one leg of the photoresistor to the A0 analog pin on the Arduino.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the GND pin on the Arduino connects to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
